question: ClickHouse Cloud was in scope to document here but is already held as compute/clickhouse-cloud (trial-only, USD 300 credits over 30 days, documented). Should a databases-kv record be added for the same vendor, or does the existing compute record cover it?
why: The dedup check scripts/fr search ClickHouse returned compute/clickhouse-cloud and scripts/fr entity ClickHouse resolved to it; a duplicate in databases-kv would violate the one-provider-one-file rule. Out of scope to change a compute record from this unit.
